gloss: to negotiate; to call to each other

definitions.explanation: To discuss terms or make a request to someone with authority; to go back and forth in discussion.

definitions.gloss: to call to each other; to exchange words
definitions.explanation: For two or more people to speak to each other, often taking turns in dialogue.

⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{掛|か}け{合|あ}って⟦{休暇|きゅうか}→休暇：02547_kyuuka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I negotiated with my boss and got vacation time.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{掛|か}ける→掛ける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to engage) + ⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ (to do together/mutually). Has two distinct senses: negotiation and reciprocal speech.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- Uses に for the person negotiated with: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{掛|か}け{合|あ}う

ASPECT (ている):
{掛|か}け{合|あ}っている means "is in the process of negotiating" or "are exchanging words" (ongoing action).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{掛|か}け{合|あ}う (to negotiate with ~)
- ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}け{合|あ}う (to call out to each other)
- ⟦{台詞|せりふ}→台詞：04038_serifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}け{合|あ}う (to exchange lines — theater)
- {掛|か}け{合|あ}って⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧もらう (to negotiate and get permission)
